newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Sept qtr expenditure on GDP rose 0.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: NZ Sept qtr expenditure on GDP rose 0.9 pct.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand on Thursday released unofficial estimates of expenditure on real gross domestic product for the quarter ended September 30, 1996, at constant 1991-92 prices (revised from figures in brackets).
Seasonally-adjusted percentage change from previous qtr at constant 1991/92 prices:
Sept 1996 yr June 1996 yr Sept 1995 yr

Note - A Reuters survey of economists had forecast real seasonally adjusted expenditure on GDP would rise 0.42 percent in the quarter for a seasonally adjusted annual average rise of 1.23 percent and an actual annual rise of 1.15 percent.
